note: Each template pairs a semantic scenario (LLM step) with a checkable property (tool step). `signals` are greppable hints for the offline deterministic matcher; `confirmers` are the tools that can prove the property. Extend freely — ids must be unique.

templates.scenario: A function performs an external call or native-value transfer and then mutates contract state that the call depended on, or calls an untrusted contract before settling balances.
templates.property: Every state variable that guards the external interaction is committed before the call (checks-effects-interactions), or the function is wrapped by a non-reentrant guard.
templates.q1: Deploy an attacker contract whose receive()/fallback re-enters the target before the first external call returns; assert the tracked balance or accounting invariant is violated.

templates.scenario: A state-changing or privileged function (mint, burn, withdraw, setOwner, upgrade, pause, setFee, rescue) is externally callable with no owner/role check.
templates.property: Every privileged entry point enforces caller authorization (onlyOwner/AccessControl role/explicit msg.sender check) before mutating protected state.
templates.q1: From an unprivileged account, call the privileged function directly and assert the protected state changes (ownership moves, tokens mint, funds leave).

templates.scenario: The boolean return of a low-level call/send/delegatecall is ignored, so a silent failure is treated as success.
templates.property: Every low-level call's success flag is checked (require/if-revert) before the function proceeds as if it succeeded.
templates.q1: Force the external call to fail (revert in the callee) and assert the caller still treats the operation as successful, leaving inconsistent state.

templates.scenario: A price or exchange rate is derived from spot AMM reserves or a single balanceOf reading rather than a manipulation-resistant oracle (TWAP/Chainlink).
templates.property: Prices used for value-bearing decisions come from a manipulation-resistant source; a single-block reserve/balance read cannot move the quoted price.
templates.q1: In a forked/local test, take a flash loan, skew the pool reserves, trigger the price-dependent path, and assert value is extracted at the manipulated price.

templates.scenario: delegatecall targets an address that is user-supplied or mutable without strict validation, letting an attacker execute code in the contract's storage context.
templates.property: delegatecall targets are fixed or governed by a trusted allowlist; no externally-influenced address can be delegatecalled.
templates.q1: Supply an attacker-controlled implementation address to the delegatecall path and assert arbitrary storage writes (e.g. overwrite the owner slot).

templates.scenario: Authorization compares against tx.origin, which a malicious intermediary contract can satisfy via a phishing call.
templates.property: Authorization uses msg.sender (or a signature), never tx.origin.
templates.q1: Route the call through an attacker contract so tx.origin is the victim while msg.sender is the attacker, and assert the tx.origin check passes.

templates.scenario: A signed message is verified with ecrecover but the signed payload lacks a nonce, deadline, or chain/domain separator, allowing replay.
templates.property: Every accepted signature is bound to a consumed nonce and a domain separator (EIP-712), so it cannot be replayed across calls or chains.
templates.q1: Submit a captured valid signature twice (or on a second chain id) and assert both submissions succeed.

templates.scenario: selfdestruct (or a delegatecalled library that can) is reachable from an unauthorized path.
templates.property: selfdestruct is unreachable by an unauthorized caller.
templates.q1: From an unprivileged account reach the selfdestruct path and assert the contract code is removed (balance swept).

templates.scenario: Request-derived input is concatenated or template-interpolated into a SQL string passed to a driver, instead of being bound as a parameter.
templates.property: No taint path exists from request input to the SQL string; all user values are bound parameters.
templates.q1: Against the LOCAL instance, send a boolean-based payload (e.g. `' OR '1'='1`) and a negative variant to the endpoint and assert the responses diverge.

templates.scenario: Request-derived input flows into child_process exec/execSync (or spawn with shell:true) as part of the command string.
templates.property: User input never becomes part of a shell command string; commands use argument arrays with no shell, or input is strictly validated against an allowlist.
templates.q1: Against the LOCAL instance, inject a sentinel command (e.g. `; echo VERIFY-$RANDOM`) and assert the sentinel marker appears in the response or local side effect.

templates.scenario: Request-derived input is joined into a filesystem path passed to fs read/write or res.sendFile without normalization/containment.
templates.property: Resolved paths are confined to an intended base directory; `../` sequences cannot escape it.
templates.q1: Against the LOCAL instance, request a traversal path (e.g. `..%2f..%2fetc%2fpasswd`) and assert out-of-root content is returned.

templates.scenario: Request-derived input is used as the URL/host for an outbound fetch/axios/http request with no allowlist.
templates.property: Outbound request targets are validated against an allowlist; user input cannot select an arbitrary internal host/metadata endpoint.
templates.q1: Against the LOCAL instance, point the target URL at a LOCAL canary server and assert the application fetches it (observed on the canary).

templates.scenario: A recursive merge/extend/set assigns object keys from user input without blocking __proto__/constructor/prototype keys.
templates.property: Merge/assign operations reject or skip __proto__/constructor/prototype keys so attacker input cannot alter Object.prototype.
templates.q1: Against the LOCAL instance, POST a payload with a `__proto__` key and assert a polluted default property is later observed on an unrelated object/response.

templates.scenario: Untrusted input is passed to node-serialize unserialize, eval, Function, or vm without a sandbox.
templates.property: No untrusted input reaches a code-evaluating sink; deserialization uses a safe, data-only parser.
templates.q1: Against the LOCAL instance, submit a serialized payload with an immediately-invoked function carrying a sentinel side effect and assert the sentinel fires locally.

templates.scenario: A route handler loads or mutates a resource by an id taken from the request without verifying the caller owns or may access it (IDOR).
templates.property: Every resource access checks caller ownership/authorization against the requested id before returning or mutating data.
templates.q1: Against the LOCAL instance, authenticate as user A and request user B's resource id; assert B's data is returned.

templates.scenario: Request-derived input is written into an HTML response or DOM sink (res.send, innerHTML, dangerouslySetInnerHTML) without encoding.
templates.property: User input rendered into HTML is contextually encoded or sanitized; it cannot introduce active markup.
templates.q1: Against the LOCAL instance, submit an input containing a unique marker tag and assert it is reflected unencoded in the HTML response.

templates.scenario: Request-derived input is f-string/%/+ interpolated into a SQL string passed to cursor.execute, instead of using bound parameters.
templates.property: No taint path from request input to the SQL string; all user values are bound via execute parameters.
templates.q1: Against the LOCAL instance, send a boolean-based payload and its negation to the endpoint and assert the responses diverge.

templates.scenario: Request-derived input flows into os.system, subprocess with shell=True, os.popen, or commands.getoutput.
templates.property: User input never becomes part of a shell string; subprocess calls use argument lists with shell=False, or input is allowlisted.
templates.q1: Against the LOCAL instance, inject a sentinel command and assert the sentinel marker appears in the response or a local side effect.

templates.scenario: Request-derived input is joined into a filesystem path passed to open/send_file without containment.
templates.property: Resolved paths are confined to an intended base directory; traversal sequences cannot escape it.
templates.q1: Against the LOCAL instance, request a traversal path and assert out-of-root file content is returned.

templates.scenario: Request-derived input is used as the URL for requests/urllib/httpx without an allowlist.
templates.property: Outbound request targets are validated against an allowlist; user input cannot select an internal host/metadata endpoint.
templates.q1: Against the LOCAL instance, point the target URL at a LOCAL canary server and assert the application fetches it.

templates.scenario: Untrusted input is passed to pickle.loads, yaml.load (unsafe loader), jsonpickle, or marshal.
templates.property: No untrusted input reaches an object-constructing deserializer; data uses a safe loader (yaml.safe_load, json).
templates.q1: Against the LOCAL instance, submit a crafted pickle/yaml payload whose __reduce__ writes a sentinel file locally and assert the sentinel appears.

templates.scenario: Request-derived input is concatenated into a Jinja/template string passed to render_template_string or Template().render.
templates.property: User input is passed as template *data*, never compiled as template *source*.
templates.q1: Against the LOCAL instance, submit `{{7*7}}` (and a Jinja arithmetic marker) and assert the evaluated result appears in the response.

templates.scenario: XML from request input is parsed with external entity / DTD resolution enabled (lxml with resolve_entities, xml.etree without defenses).
templates.property: XML parsing disables external entities, DTDs, and network access for untrusted documents.
templates.q1: Against the LOCAL instance, submit an XML doc with a DOCTYPE entity referencing a LOCAL file/canary and assert the entity is resolved.

templates.scenario: Superglobal input is concatenated into a SQL string passed to mysqli_query/PDO::query instead of a prepared statement.
templates.property: No taint path from superglobal input to the SQL string; queries are prepared with bound parameters.
templates.q1: Against the LOCAL instance, send a boolean-based payload and its negation and assert the responses diverge.

templates.scenario: Superglobal input flows into system/exec/shell_exec/passthru/popen as part of the command string.
templates.property: User input never becomes part of a shell command; calls use escaped, allowlisted arguments or avoid the shell entirely.
templates.q1: Against the LOCAL instance, inject a sentinel command and assert the sentinel marker appears in the response or a local side effect.

templates.scenario: Superglobal input is used in include/require/include_once path, allowing local or remote file inclusion.
templates.property: Included paths come from a fixed allowlist; user input cannot select the included file.
templates.q1: Against the LOCAL instance, set the page parameter to a traversal path or php://filter wrapper and assert unintended file content is included.

templates.scenario: Superglobal/untrusted input is passed to unserialize(), enabling PHP object injection via magic methods.
templates.property: Untrusted input is never unserialize()d; data uses json_decode or an allowlisted class set.
templates.q1: Against the LOCAL instance, submit a serialized object targeting a gadget whose magic method writes a sentinel locally and assert the sentinel appears.

templates.scenario: Superglobal input is echoed/printed into HTML without htmlspecialchars encoding.
templates.property: User input rendered into HTML is encoded with htmlspecialchars/htmlentities in the correct context.
templates.q1: Against the LOCAL instance, submit a unique marker tag and assert it is reflected unencoded in the HTML response.

templates.scenario: Request-derived input is fmt.Sprintf/concatenated into a SQL string passed to db.Query/Exec instead of using placeholders.
templates.property: No taint path from request input to the SQL string; queries use parameter placeholders.
templates.q1: Against the LOCAL instance, send a boolean-based payload and its negation and assert the responses diverge.

templates.scenario: Request-derived input is passed to exec.Command via a shell (sh -c) or concatenated into the command string.
templates.property: User input is passed as a discrete argument to exec.Command without a shell, or allowlisted.
templates.q1: Against the LOCAL instance, inject a sentinel command and assert the sentinel marker appears in the response or a local side effect.

templates.scenario: Request-derived input is joined into a filesystem path passed to os.Open/ioutil/http.ServeFile without containment.
templates.property: Resolved paths are confined to a base directory via filepath.Clean + prefix check; traversal cannot escape.
templates.q1: Against the LOCAL instance, request a traversal path and assert out-of-root file content is returned.

templates.scenario: Request-derived input is used as the URL for http.Get/http.NewRequest without an allowlist.
templates.property: Outbound request targets are validated against an allowlist; user input cannot select an internal host/metadata endpoint.
templates.q1: Against the LOCAL instance, point the target URL at a LOCAL canary server and assert the application fetches it.
